lines: The app ships no composer/autoload.php, so the server registers its generic loader for lib/ and looks every class up in the file system.

A composer/composer.json with config.vendor-dir ".", config.optimize-autoloader true, a config.autoloader-suffix and autoload.psr-4 {"OCA\\ArbeitszeitCheck\\": "../lib/"} makes composer dump-autoload write composer/autoload.php with a class map; the code of the app does not change.
The Composer autoloader is optimized beyond level 1. The manual allows only config.optimize-autoloader: an authoritative class map breaks the upgrade of the app, and APCu is no required extension.
3 classes in lib/ whose name does not follow PSR-4 below OCA\ArbeitszeitCheck, the namespace the server derives from <namespace> of info.xml. The loader of the server does not find such a class.
7 uses of the private API of the server in 4 files. Only OCP and NCU are public: what is below OC changes without notice between majors.

1 inline script in templates/. The Content Security Policy of the server runs neither a <script> without a source or the nonce of the response nor an event handler attribute, so the browser does not run them. A script added with OCP\Util::addScript() or addInitScript() runs.
1 place loads a user with IUserManager::get() only to ask for the display name. IUserManager::getDisplayName(), there since Nextcloud 25, answers from a cache and loads no user.

Nothing in the app calls 33 routes outside OCS. Looked for: a route name or a path in the PHP source and the templates, in 91 files of the frontend source and in the navigation of info.xml. The frontend puts the path of the app and the rest of a URL together at run time, so every text there that reads like a path below the app counted as a call. A route stays behind when the frontend stops calling it. A route that only a client outside the app calls shows here as well, unless its method allows requests from other origins (CORS).
The frontend or a template builds 22 URLs below /apps/arbeitszeitcheck/ that no route of the app matches. The request fails at run time.

phpunit/phpunit is in require-dev of composer.json. The manual recommends a vendor-bin/ of bamarni/composer-bin-plugin per tool, so that the dependencies of a tool cannot conflict with those of the app.
